Ana R: hey team - taking primary now for the 12:00-20:00 UTC block, FYI I'm pairing with Maya S as a shadow for her first formal on-call shift :wave:
Ana R: quick summary of open context before I sign on: last night's tokenization spike (INC-2231) had a fallback but triggered higher retries for hosted API in us-west; mitigated by temporary autoscale and cache warmup. We have a residual degradation risk around 1k seq requests that cause long tail latency.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2231 - Tokenization retry storm - currently RESOLVED -> See incident log: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2231 (root cause: upstream tokenizer OOMs, mitigation: scaled dedupe workers + short TTL cache)
Ben K: thanks Ana. for clarity who is secondary for this shift?
Ana R: Ben K you'll be secondary. Oliver T you cover late-night escalation if anything crosses SLA (we still have the dedicated page rotation for that).
Oliver T: noted. I only have a 19:00-23:00 UTC overlap today, after that I'm on-call for infra but out of pager for 00:00-06:00 UTC tomorrow (travel). if we get anything that might need infra escalation after 23:30 i'll need a handoff.
Maya S: thanks Ana - quick ask: can we run through the runbook steps now? I want to be comfortable with the mitigation flow and the customer impact checklist before I take any pages.
Ana R: yup - brief runbook excerpt below (also linked in runbooks/oncall/tokenization.md)
Ana R: ```
# Tokenizer retry storm - triage checklist
1) Check incident dashboard (Console -> Incidents) for spike by model region
2) Run quick query: curl -s "https://metrics.api/queries?name=tokenizer_retries&window=15m" | jq '.values[-1]'
3) If retries > 500/s, start temporary dedupe worker pool: /deploy/scale dedupe --replicas=6 --region=us-west
4) Warm KV cache: job start job/warm-kv --prefix=tokenizer-cache --ttl=300
5) Notify customers on impacted routes: use templates/oncall/tokenization-template.md
6) If error-rate > 5% for >10m, escalate to infra and legal for potential SLA breach
```
Ben K: small note - step 3 uses the internal deploy tool; if you're shadowing, use the web console button under "Control -> Scale Pools" if you don't have deploy perms.
Ana R: good call. Maya, i'll walk you through console steps now (15min Zoom). after that i'll handover primary to you at 16:00 UTC for the last 4 hours so you can practice handling lower-severity pages with me nearby.
Maya S: perfect, ping me the Zoom link and the checklist you want me to run live. also want to practice drafting the customer-facing note (short template)
Ana R: template snippet: "We observed elevated retry rates impacting tokenization for a subset of requests in us-west. We scaled workers and warmed caches; we are monitoring and will follow up if we observe further customer impact." use the template file to fill incident numbers.
oncall-bot: REMINDER - On-call handover in 15 minutes for shift 12:00-20:00 UTC. Please acknowledge.
Ben K: acknowledging. :eyes:
Oliver T: acknowledged. safe shadowing Maya!
Maya S: acknowledged - thanks all. quick question on paging tiers: does the on-call policy still send critical pages to primary->secondary->infra?
Ana R: yes - primary handles P0/P1; secondary only paged on P0 or when primary doesn't ack in 3m; infra is paged for P0 or if escalation hits infra-specific runbook. full policy: https://redwood.docs/oncall/policy.md
Ben K: coverage gap note: we're short-staffed on Sundays 02:00-08:00 UTC for the month of May. Ops and rotations team know, but if anything that hits latency SLOs during that window we'll need to invoke the on-call mutual aid (paging adjacent region leads). I'll post a follow-up in #general after this thread.
Ana R: thanks Ben — i'll add that to the handoff notes and tag the rotations doc. Maya, once we finish the console walkthrough i'll assign you the test page (non-prod) so you can practice acknowledging and running staged mitigations.
Maya S: sounds good. can someone drop the exact non-prod alert name?
Ana R: use "test.alert.tokenizer.retry" in staging - it triggers the same mitigation playbook but doesn't hit customers.
Ben K: FYI if you trigger the test page, monitor the dedupe queue length and check worker logs: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=dedupe -f`
Oliver T: also, if you need to create a partial customer notification, ping me. I can review for SLA language.
Ana R: handoff checklist i'll add to the shift note after this thread: - summary of recent incidents - mitigation state and risk - primary/secondary/infra contacts - runbook links + quick commands - test page name for shadowing - expected gaps (sundays 02-08 UTC) - Zoom link for pairing
Maya S: thanks Ana, i'm ready for the walkthrough in 5m.
Ana R: link: https://zoom.redwood/abc123 - i'll start the screen share. 
Ben K: thanks everyone, i'll be reachable on slack and pager. GL with the shadowing :thumbsup:
Ana R: handing over to Maya at 16:00 UTC will be annotated in the shift notes. ending thread for now.
